mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in monthly employment (PAYEMS) signals robust labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS shows no sustained upward trend over 6 months or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the unemployment rate threshold (UNRATE > 9.0%) triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days, reflecting market anxiety about labor market weakness.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.4 percentage points in one month
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross above 9.0% or 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of ultra-low federal funds rates (<1%) and rising employment (PAYEMS) creates a positive feedback loop, lowering borrowing costs and stimulating equity valuations, driving 20-day forward returns positively.
failure_condition: Either FEDFUNDS ≥ 1% or PAYEMS not increasing, or 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (rising FEDFUNDS), S&P 500 forward returns turn negative over the next 60 trading days as higher interest rates suppress equity valuations.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not rise in the tightening cycle or 60-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust supply-side growth, enhancing corporate profitability and investor confidence, leading to positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not show a sustained upward trend over 6 months or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) crosses above 100 (indicating expansion), S&P 500 forward returns become positive over the next 5 trading days as market anticipates sustained supply growth.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not cross above 100 or 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in both GDP growth (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal robust demand, driving up corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in positive 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and RSAFS both increase in the last month
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or RSAFS does not increase, or 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle demand surge regime, sustained growth in GDP (GDPC1) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days as markets anticipate prolonged economic expansion.
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not show sustained growth in the regime or 60-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
